info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Trade Confirmation Matching API
info.description: The Trade Confirmation Matching API facilitates the synchronization and validation of trade confirmations between trading parties. This endpoint allows users to update the confirmation statuses and reconcile discrepancies efficiently. Typical consumers include trading platforms, compliance systems, and financial institutions that require accurate matching of trade confirmations to ensure regulatory compliance. By leveraging this API, users can streamline their operations, reduce unintended risks, and enhance communication between counterparties.
